title: Fire mage: the party threat back-off keeps the mob off the mage under a player tank

rules.desc: No mob hits the fire mage while a player tank holds the mobs (the back-off stops the nukes at 80 percent of the tank's threat)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:11-75 (ThreatMultiplier: a single-target or AoE damage action scores 0 while 'high threat' is active); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:640-669 (HighThreatTrigger: 80 percent of the tank's threat, with a 5 s look-ahead); ai/playerbot/strategy/values/ThreatValues.cpp:78-159 (tank threat = the highest IsTank member); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:473-489,842-850 (KeepsPartyThreatBackoff: a non-tank bot with a real master gets the threat strategy); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.h:39 (spell actions are ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE); commit 320aa2906 (#922: vetoed nukes fall back to the wand on purpose)
rules.why_expect: the nukes are vetoed at 80 percent, but since #922 the mage falls back to Shoot while the veto holds, and the wand keeps adding threat. Against a player tank with no gear (taunting every 10 s from the runner) the wand alone may reach the 130 percent a ranged attacker needs to pull. This is the question the trial answers

rules.desc: Precondition: the mage does fight (at least 3 fire nukes on the mobs), so the no-aggro rule is not passing because the mage stood idle
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/FireMageStrategy.cpp:27,34-48 (fireball default, fire blast and scorch rows); ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:40-75 (the veto only holds while 'high threat' is active)
rules.why_expect: below 80 percent of the tank's threat nothing vetoes the nukes, and every taunt from the player resets the ratio

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight, so the role read by the bot is the one this trial is about
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:446-471 (GetPlayerRoles) unless the forced role decides first (ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:3986-3990)
rules.why_expect: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start; the runner's threat cast every 6 s keeps the player in the stance's rotation
